function.name: SetFunctions
function.description: Sets every function to add or change, as signatures and documentation only. Call again to change them: each function listed replaces the earlier one of the same name in its module, functions not listed stay, and remove drops earlier ones.

module.description: The module from SetTypes the function is in

name.description: Function name; an existing function's name in its module replaces it

signature.description: The type only, without the name or ::, e.g. "[Row] -> Either ParseError Table"

doc.description: What the function does, precisely enough to implement from the types and this text alone. Agent context only; never written into source. Describe the function, never the change. Existing source comments are preserved

change.description: For an existing function: what to change, for its implementer only; never written into the code. Empty for a new function

model.description: Which model implements the function, when the instructions offer a choice: the cheapest that will get it right. Leave it out for the default

module.description: The module the function was recorded in

remove.description: Functions recorded earlier to drop from the design
